label: Thermal stress score (vs control bed)
description: leaf minus control-bed leaf temperature, as a z-score against the plant's own 30 Aug–2 Sep values at the same time of day

label: Thermal stress score (no control bed)
description: leaf minus air temperature above a line in VPD fitted on healthy plants (24 Aug–2 Sep), as a z-score against the plant's own baseline

label: Leaf − air above the published sugar beet line
description: leaf minus air temperature minus Idso's (1982) non-water-stressed sugar beet line, 2.50 − 1.92 × VPD (kPa)
